_comment: Copy to providers.json (gitignored) and edit. serve.py reads it at every
request, so edits take effect without a restart.
Keys stay on this machine. The browser is told only that a provider HAS a
key, never what it is, and every request is proxied by serve.py — which
also means no CORS configuration and no key in devtools.
kind: 'openai' means the provider implements POST {base}/v1/audio/transcriptions
in the OpenAI shape. That covers OpenAI itself, Groq, Fireworks, Together,
llama-swap, faster-whisper-server, whisper.cpp's server, and most others.
role tells the interface which tier a model can fill before it has run:
both   - fills the word tier and the phone tier from one pass
speakers - who is talking; fills the speaker tier and nothing else
The response is believed over this hint; it exists so the queue can show
